summary.text: Deb Manjarrez is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives for District 14-Position 2, in office since January 13, 2025, and she is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Ezequiel Morfin.
A certified public accountant and farm owner from Wapato, she is serving her first term.

paragraphs.text: Manjarrez was born and raised in Wapato, Washington, and is a fourth-generation member of a farming family who owns, with her husband Mark, a farm that has been in the family since the 1940s, according to Wikipedia.
She graduated from Wapato High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Central Washington University and is a certified public accountant.

Manjarrez served as president of the Wapato Chamber of Commerce for ten years, helped found the Wapato Tamale Festival, chaired the Yakima County Republican Central Committee and served as a Republican state committeewoman.
She ran in 2024 for the seat of retiring Republican Gina Mosbrucker and defeated Democrat Ana Ruiz Kennedy in the general election with 51 percent of the vote.
Her House Republican biography says she received the 2026 Representative of the Year Award from the Washington State Narcotics Investigators Association.
